In '''1992–93''', the Serie A title was retained by [[A.C. Milan|Milan]], who finished four points ahead of [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]]. Third placed [[Parma F.C.|Parma]] enjoyed European glory in the [[European Cup Winners Cup]], while unfancied [[Cagliari Calcio|Cagliari]] crept into the [[UEFA Cup]] qualification places at the expense of the 1991 champions and 1992 European Cup finalists [[U.C. Sampdoria|Sampdoria]]. [[A.S. Roma|Roma]] and [[S.S.C. Napoli|Napoli]] finished mid table after disappointing campaigns, while [[Brescia Calcio|Brescia]], [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]], [[U.S. Ancona 1905|Ancona]] and [[Delfino Pescara 1936|Pescara]] were all relegated.

==Teams==
[[Brescia Calcio|Brescia]], [[Pescara Calcio|Pescara]], [[AC Ancona|Ancona]] and [[Udinese]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
